summary.en: Economic activity subclass codes of the CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 table.
summary.pt-BR: Códigos de subclasse de atividade econômica da tabela CNAE-Subclasses 2.3.

format.summary: Formats a CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) subclass code.
description: Formats a CNAE subclass code with the mask `NNNN-N/NN`; only the structure changes (use `cnae.isValid` to check the code).
- The mask is applied as far as the digits go; `options.pad` left-pads with zeros to 7 digits first.
- Characters other than digits are dropped; a number is read as the string of its digits.
- Returns an empty string when there is no digit at all.

get.summary: Looks a CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) subclass code up in the official CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 table, the current subclass revision of CNAE 2.0.
description: Looks a CNAE subclass code up in the CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 table and returns its code (7 bare digits) and official description.
- Same input rules as `cbo.get`, with 7 digits and the `NNNN-N/NN` mask.
- Returns null for an unknown code or a value not in an accepted form.

returns.description: DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PROGRAMAS DE COMPUTADOR SOB ENCOMENDA
DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PROGRAMAS DE COMPUTADOR SOB ENCOMENDA

isValid.summary: Validates if a CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) subclass code exists in the official CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 table, the current subclass revision of CNAE 2.0.
description: Checks whether a CNAE subclass code exists in the CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 table (the current subclass revision of CNAE 2.0).
- Same input rules as `cbo.isValid`, with 7 digits and the `NNNN-N/NN` mask: bare digits are left-padded to 7, a masked value is read as written, other strings are rejected.

parse.summary: Removes CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) formatting characters and returns only digits.
description: Removes CNAE formatting and keeps only digits, capped to 7 digits.
- Nothing is left-padded; a partial code is kept as written.

tests.name: caps-length
tests.note: reference truncates to the 7 characters of the document; asserted by the reference (JS) unit tests
